title: A lost bag at the station
checked: Every reachable state checked (5 states, 8 with their data, 11 steps). All 4 rules hold.

rules.rule: Every step can happen, and none is a dead end
rules.says: Each of the 5 states is reached from the start, every step can fire, and no state leaves you stuck.
A wait with no answer moves the bag up one level, never two.
Lost property is the top. Nobody passes it on from there.
The bag is found only when someone at a level answers.
